newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-JURGENSEN LEADS MISSISSIPPI GOLF BY TWO STROKES.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-JURGENSEN LEADS MISSISSIPPI GOLF BY TWO STROKES.

text.p: shot a 69 to take a two-shot lead after the third round of the
$1 million Deposit Guaranty Classic on Saturday.
Steve Lowery, Billy Ray Brown, Brian Claar and Don Pooley
are two strokes off the pace at 204 after 54 holes.
"I haven't played with a lot of these guys, but I've seen
a lot of them on TV," said the 35-year-old Jurgenson, who
would earn $180,000 and a two year exemption from qualifying
for the PGA Tour if he wins here.
